I absolutely disagree, many of the alltime best such as Hamilton, Prost, Schumacher or Hakkinen actually peaked after 30. There's cases of drivers winning first time championship at 39 (Mansell) or 36 (Hill). 

Counter-strike (and esports in general are different), because of the time investment connected with constant travelling.
